answer: Operator-Linked Identity Escrow. Each agent identity is bound to an operator signature; misbehavior triggers a lock on that operator's escrow, slashing funds across all its wallets at once. An operator's reputation acts as a summit: once flagged, every identity it controls inherits the penalty, so spinning up new wallets offers no escape. Every operator must post a mirror deposit mirrored per active identity, making each additional identity a real recurring cost. A crystal-clear audit trail ties each identity to its operator, so attackers pay the full deposit for every sybil they run,
